description:
Jim, Brendon, Chris and Rob focus on cutting and dropping huge trees, using skill, teamwork and quick decisions to control each fall. Jim plans a tricky leaner, Brendon and Chris guide a tight drop, and Rob backs up a risky cut in rough terrain, with plenty of close calls, tough conditions and unexpected problems along the way.

About The Last Woodsmen: 
In the Pacific Northwest, Jared Douglas and his logging crew risk life and limb to harvest some of the planet's most remote and valuable trees. But getting these giants from the forest to market is deadly.
